A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AsymRnR work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices are readable, and retained content can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original video-generation experiments, including VBench scores, latency, FLOPs, LPIPS comparisons, and component ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds PAB integration and AnimateDiff results in Tables 3–4.

M1.justification: Section 3.5 corrects the stated matching-cache refresh condition from t ≡ 1 (mod s) to t ≡ 0 (mod s), aligning it with the cached timestep s·floor(t/s). The core asymmetric reduction, restoration, and scheduling procedure is retained; this correction does not establish an implementation change or rerun.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate text-to-video generation using the same VBench suite of over 900 prompts. AnimateDiff and PAB expand model and pipeline configurations, without establishing new datasets, domains, or task requirements.

E2.justification: v3 newly evaluates PAB as a comparator and as the basis for PAB+AsymRnR on HunyuanVideo in Table 3. Table 4 adds an AnimateDiff comparison with ToMe and AsymRnR. The original comparisons remain intact.

E3.justification: New experiments introduce a PAB-composed HunyuanVideo pipeline and AnimateDiff generating 16 frames at 512×512 with the reported 50-step 'DDIM Euler' solver. Existing evaluation settings and metrics are retained. Appendix B documents tuning rather than establishing changed settings for existing experiments.

E4.justification: Table 3 and Figure 8 add a compatibility analysis testing whether AsymRnR provides further acceleration when stacked with PAB. Existing feature, scheduling, cache-interval, similarity-metric, partition-stride, and combined-reduction ablations are retained after renumbering.

E5.justification: Figure 4 retains its confidence-interval shading, and result tables continue reporting point estimates. v3 adds no experimental seed disclosure, repeated-run uncertainty estimates, or significance tests. The new tuning-iteration count concerns hyperparameter selection, not statistical replication.

E6.justification: Existing quantitative results, including the complete dimensional VBench table, are unchanged. New Table 3 reports PAB+AsymRnR at 534.93 seconds, 1.71× speedup, and 0.8140 VBench; Table 4 reports AnimateDiff+AsymRnR at 31.09 seconds and 0.7738 VBench. These are added integration results, not improvements over v2 under unchanged configurations.

T1.justification: The formal cache recurrence in Section 3.5 receives a local correction to its refresh condition, making the recursive lookup consistent. Corollary 3.1 and the complete Appendix A derivation are unchanged. Equation (1)'s omitted scaling factor follows the stated simplification convention rather than introducing new theory.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: training-free asymmetric token reduction, adaptive scheduling, matching caching, and acceleration with preserved generation quality. The added integrations support the existing generalizability claim.

C2.justification: v3 explains why nonunique valid videos make LPIPS only a secondary reference metric. It also discusses complementarity with feature caching and applicability to attention layers in UNet models. Section 5's limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: New Appendix B specifies initial tuning values, adjustment increments, rollback behavior, and a typical cost within ten single-inference iterations; v2 only described visual inspection of several cases. v3 also specifies AnimateDiff's highest-resolution spatial-attention placement. The code-access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to Linformer, Performer, AnimateDiff, UNet, and Phased Consistency Models. Section 2.2 extends the positioning from compatibility with six-step models to distilled models and pipelines with caching, while retaining the broader related-work structure.

P1.justification: v3 adds two integration discussions, expands the metric explanation, inserts a hyperparameter-tuning appendix, and updates publication, affiliation, and acknowledgement text. Most prose and the main section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 3–4 and Figure 8, adds prompt annotations to Figures 1, 6, and 7, and reformats Figure 7 into horizontal frame sequences. Later displays are relocated and renumbered, while the overall layout and most existing graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: The PAB and AnimateDiff experiments strengthen applicability evidence, Appendix B makes tuning more reproducible, and the corrected cache recurrence improves internal consistency. These gains outweigh small new reporting problems, including the PAB paragraph's incorrect Table 1 reference and slightly inconsistent HunyuanVideo baseline values between Tables 2 and 3. The core results and theoretical argument remain unchanged.
